name: Default
shortDescription: Centralized SSH gateway for remote access to Linux devices behind NAT or firewalls, with a web console, browser terminal and PostgreSQL storage.

alerts.message: Open the app right after deploying: until the first account exists every page redirects to /setup, and whoever completes it becomes the instance superadmin.
Only HTTP(S) is routed, so devices connect and the web terminal works, but native SSH clients cannot reach the server's SSH port (2222 in the container).
This image runs on x86_64 servers only.
